{{Quote|No expense spared. Even a little flight suit. Mirgo Ruus makes good ones.|Kal Skirata|<ref name="O66" />}}
'''Mirgo Ruus''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Ruus made a living crafting Mandalorian [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suits]], and over time, developed a reputation for quality work.<ref name="O66" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY]], the veteran Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] considered approaching Ruus to tailor a flight suit for his young grandson, [[Venku Skirata]].<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mirgo Ruus was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], the fourth entry in [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]]' [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]], published [[September 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="O66" />
